description: Dutch neighbourhood profile in English for any postcode or CBS neighbourhood code: residents and age mix, housing and home values, income, energy use, distances to 18 amenities, police-registered crime vs the national rate, and Leefbaarometer liveability. No exact address needed. Sources: CBS, Politie, Leefbaarometer. Costs $0.01 USDC via x402, or one unit of a Factline API key quota.

code.description: Alternative: CBS neighbourhood code, e.g. BU05182245

postcode.description: Any Dutch postcode in the neighbourhood, e.g. 2517AS
